task_description: Summarise the given news article in English.

axes.name: sentence_length
axes.description: 문장 길이가 길고 복잡한가, 아니면 짧고 간결한가를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Write sentences that are relatively long and contain multiple clauses or detailed information.
Write short, simple sentences with minimal clauses.

axes.name: detail_density
axes.description: 문장당 포함된 정보량과 세부사항의 밀도를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Include multiple facts and details within each sentence to provide dense information.
Keep sentences light on details, focusing on one fact or idea per sentence.

axes.name: sentence_count
axes.description: 답변 내 문장 수가 많은가 적은가를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Use only a few sentences (2-3) to summarise the content.
Use a moderate number of sentences (around 4) to summarise the content.
Use many sentences (5 or more) to provide a detailed summary.

axes.name: focus_on_facts
axes.description: 사실 전달에 집중하는지, 아니면 해석이나 평가를 포함하는지 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Focus on reporting factual information without adding personal opinions or interpretations.
Include interpretations, opinions, or evaluations alongside factual information.
